entries.author: Vitaly V. Kuzmin
entries.note: 50P6E launcher in travel order, front quarter: the BAZ-6909's long flat-fronted cab-forward cab with its two windscreens, the twelve-canister box stowed flat over the rear, red caps forward.

entries.author: Vitaly V. Kuzmin
entries.note: Right side in travel order: four axles in two pairs, the short cab and the equipment housings behind it, the canister box's two lattice rows flat over the rear axles; the frame's height was measured from this view.

entries.author: Vitaly V. Kuzmin
entries.note: Rear quarter: the canister box's heavy rear frame and its elevation hinge at the tail, the rear outriggers stowed, the lattice sides.

entries.author: Vitaly V. Kuzmin
entries.note: The canister box's rear: its frame posts and cross-members over the canister bases.

entries.author: Vitaly V. Kuzmin
entries.note: The canister mouths forward: two rows of six light grey canisters in the olive lattice frame, red transport caps.
